title.narrative: EU4Business: SME Policies and Institutions Support in Ukraine

description.narrative: This project will provide urgent wartime/post-war support to the Ukrainian institutions responsible for the economic policymaking and policies implementation, aimed to provide effective relief to the country¿s private sector suffering from the war, primarily SME. The project is aligned with the National Recovery Council¿s priority-setting and aims to deliver technical assistance towards achieving concrete results in mainstreaming the business and regulatory environment and strengthening of the business support ecosystem, including its stronger connection and integration with that of the EU.
